title: Design System: Queue Arcade LED board
scope: Describes the LED-board concept under design/poc/led-board/ only. Two layers: the shell (board.css, unprefixed tokens) and the Dota 2 skin, version 2 (theme-dota.css, dota- tokens) loaded after it by index-dota.html and play-dota.html on body.skin-dota. The shipped Next.js app (CSS modules under src/components) is not covered.

extensions.elevation: None. Depth is three blacks: ground #101010, module #000000, ghost #1b1b1b. Two dot stencils (art-module screen door: 40% black dots on a 3px grid; verdict placeholder: ghost-2 dots on an 8px grid) add texture without light. Dota 2 skin: flat slate ground (#0d1217) with no seam grid; ladder well #0a0e12, ground, module #141b21, ghost #1e272e. Every module, cell, and action carries a 1px gold hairline (rgba(199,164,96,0.34)) over a 1px #070a0d inset line (zero-blur inset box-shadow); lit fills drop the inset line. Ability-slot wells are the one bevelled surface: 1px seam-strong border over a 2px #1d262d inner bevel, which becomes a 2px #ffe08a inner frame when picked and disappears when the cell lights. Both dot stencils are removed: the art module gets a 2px rgba(199,164,96,0.5) frame with a 1px black outline inset 3px, the verdict a 1px seam top rule. Fogged Vision becomes fog of war: a #263447 wash at 78/50/26% over blur 12/6/2px.

skins.rule: A skin is one stylesheet, theme-<game>.css, loaded after board.css on a body.skin-<game> page. It may change material, type faces, and ornament, and it may add game-ritual components inside the shell's modules. It may not change the module layout, the phase geometry, the one-dot-per-percent bars, the full-band reveal flip, or the roles in the State Colour Law.

dota.mechanism: Re-points every shell :root colour variable, --font-sign, and --font-dots (both to Radiance), sets --cell-h to 144px, and adds --str, --agi, --int, --all, --play, --red-text, and --fog.
dota.markup: The skin pages add the Dota 2 logo before the sign, the HUD bar (Radiant box, dial-and-clock stack, Dire box) inside the clock module, an ability-slot well (letter, cooldown layer with padlock, hotkey badge) in each cell's head, a streak-name slot under the Streak caption, and a gold-float slot beside the points.
dota.script: board.js reads body.skin-dota to build the pick screen as four attribute groups, drive the dial's --turn, drive the picked well's --cd, fill the HUD shares at reveal, and write the +N float.
changes: Palette: slate ground and modules, Dota gold for the amber role, parchment for lit, Radiant green and Dire red for the results, Dire red text for small red, gold seams.
Frames: 1px gold hairline over 1px dark inset line on every module, cell, and action; the inset line drops on lit fills.
Type: Radiance 700 on every signage role and every readout (The One Face Rule); Barlow unchanged.

Ornament: 6px gold diamonds for LED separators, sign pixel mark hidden and the Dota 2 logo before the sign, 2px gold art frame with no screen door, verdict plate with a seam top rule, 2px attribute underline on pick-screen group headings, 8px attribute square before split-row names.
Lobby: Find Match green with a 4px darker bottom edge and white ink on the primary action only, ordered last on desktop and first under 720px.

Geometry inside the shell's modules: cells 144px (128px mobile), cell padding 14px 16px 12px, HUD grid minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(0,1fr) in the clock row, pick screen as four group columns of 44x58 tiles, actions row 1fr 1fr 2fr.
components: HUD top bar: Radiant box left (answered right), Dire box right (answered wrong), en dashes until reveal, then the right/wrong percent split.
Day-night dial: 76x38 half-disc, authored sun with eight rays while answering, crescent moon at reveal, rotated by --turn.

Ability-slot wells: 56px, dark bevel, hotkey badge bottom-right, cooldown sweep over an authored padlock once locked, breaker-gold inner frame when picked, slate slot with a green or red letter at reveal, breaker-gold blink on the crowd-breaker.
Kill-streak banner: the state line at reveal on a red strip with white Radiance, announcer names at streak 3 to 10.
Gold coin before the points stat and a +N float at reveal.
Pick screen grouped by Strength, Agility, Intelligence, Universal with the client's attribute icons from the public Dota asset host and sticky group headings inside the scroll.
Fog of war on the Fogged Vision portrait: navy wash at 78/50/26% over three blur stages.
inherited: Cells light by fill; the well inverts.
100-dot split bars, one dot per percent, 16% unlit.
700ms full-band reveal flash on every lit surface.
Reserved space for every phase; no layout shift.
Instant swaps; ticker scroll; breaker blink.
State colour roles: live, lit, right, wrong, breaker.

gradients: HUD side tints (vertical 22% to 6% of the team colour)
kill-streak banner (deep red, bright red, deep red)
gold coin (radial light gold to deep gold)

narrative.overview:
The public room is one arena LED ribbon board. The page is a matte black floor ruled into 96px panels by faint seams. On the floor sit pure black LED modules: the clock, the question, four answer cells, and the scoreboard band. Everything that carries state is light. Words are condensed arena signage in capitals. Numbers are dot-matrix. Reading text is plain Barlow in sentence case.

Nothing fades, slides, or glows. A change of state is a one-frame swap, the way a scoreboard flips. The round has four phases (entry, answering, locked, reveal) and every element keeps its box through all four, so the player's eye never has to re-find the clock or the cells. At reveal the whole band drenches in the result colour for 700ms, then drops back to black with the result still lit.

The build rejects the dark dashboard of bordered cards with one glowing accent. It has no colour gradients, no glow halos, no shadows, no rounded corners, no transitions, and no borders used to show state.

The board is a shell, and a game pack dresses it with a skin. The Dota 2 skin keeps every mechanism above and dresses the board in the client's own rituals: slate instead of black, Dota gold for the live light, Radiant green and Dire red for the result, Radiance Bold for every piece of signage, and the client's own furniture inside the shell's modules. The clock module carries the HUD top bar (Radiant and Dire boxes around the clock, with the day-night dial over it). Each answer cell carries an ability-slot well with a hotkey badge and a cooldown sweep once the answer is locked. The state line becomes a kill-streak banner at reveal. Points carry a gold coin and a "+N" float. The pick screen groups heroes by attribute under the client's icons. The Fogged Vision portrait sits under fog of war. The lobby's Play now is Find Match green. A second game pack ships its own skin file and leaves the shell alone.
keyCharacteristics: Matte ground, black modules, visible seams, zero radius.
One colour per state: amber live, white locked or waiting, green right, red wrong, white-gold only for the 2x crowd-breaker.
Unlit elements are drawn, not hidden: ghost dots at 16% opacity, unlit bar cells in ghost grey.
Dot-matrix numerals (Doto), signage capitals (Barlow Condensed), reading text (Barlow).
Every state change is instant. The only loops are the ticker scroll and the crowd-breaker blink.
Every phase-dependent element reserves its space. Nothing moves between entry, answering, locked, and reveal.
Two layers: the shell owns layout, geometry, bars, the reveal flip, and the state roles; a skin owns material, type faces, ornament, and the game's ritual components inside the shell's modules.

rules.name: The Shell-and-Skin Rule
rules.body: A skin is one stylesheet, `theme-<game>.css`, loaded after `board.css` on a `body.skin-<game>` page. It may change material, type faces, and ornament, and it may add game-ritual components inside the shell's modules (the HUD bar in the clock module, the ability-slot wells in the cells, the grouped pick screen in the hero picker). It may not change the module layout, the phase geometry, the one-dot-per-percent bars, the full-band reveal flip, or the roles in the State Colour Law. Every mechanism the shell documents is inherited by every skin unchanged.

rules.name: The State Colour Law
rules.body: Amber is live answering. Lit white is locked, waiting, or missed. Green is right. Red is wrong. White-gold is the 2x crowd-breaker keycap and nothing else. A colour is never used as decoration.

rules.name: The Lit-or-Drawn Rule
rules.body: Every surface is either emitting light in one of the five colours or drawn unlit in a black or grey. There are no colour gradients, no glows, no translucent tints. A radial-gradient appears only as a dot stencil (the art module's screen-door overlay, the verdict placeholder field), never as a colour ramp.

rules.name: The Decisive Beat Rule
rules.body: The full band changes colour once per round, at reveal. The body takes flash-right, flash-wrong, or flash-missed for 700ms: every fascia, module, and cell background becomes the result colour (green, red, or lit white), all text and indicator cells become black, and images keep their pixels. The ground stays matte. The flash is then removed in one frame and the result colour stays only on the clock, the state line, and the result cells.

rules.name: The Attribute Mark Rule
rules.body: The four attribute colours are marks, not states. They appear only as the 2px underline of a pick-screen group heading and the 8px square before a split-row name. The name beside the square keeps the state colour. An attribute colour never fills a surface, never colours text, and never stands in for green or red.

rules.name: The Client Material Rule
rules.body: The Dota 2 skin carries four recorded exceptions to the Lit-or-Drawn Rule, each a material the client itself uses: the Radiant and Dire box tints (a vertical fade from 22% to 6% of the team colour), the kill-streak banner (deep red at the ends, brighter red at the centre), the gold coin (a radial from light gold to deep gold), and the fog-of-war wash (a translucent navy over the portrait). No other surface in the skin carries a gradient or a tint, and none of these four is ever used as a state.

rules.name: The Small Red Rule
rules.body: The fill red (`dota-red`) is a surface colour. Red text smaller than the clock uses `dota-red-text`, and the Dire caption uses `dota-dire-caption`, so a wrong result stays readable on slate.

rules.name: The Signage Caps Rule
rules.body: Every heading, label, state line, and button label is Barlow Condensed in uppercase with tracking between 0.01em (display) and 0.14em (the sign). Sentence case is only for Barlow reading text.

rules.name: The Dot Readout Rule
rules.body: A readout is Doto: the clock, the round number, percentages, points, streaks, round counts, slot counts, the volume percent, and scored amounts inside the verdict. A digit that is part of a label or a signage line stays in the signage face, as in the answer label "2,250 gold" and the state line "Locked at 00:13".

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: In the Dota 2 skin every signage role and every readout is Radiance at weight 700. There is no second display face and no dot face; the Dot Readout Rule is replaced by re-pointing the shell's dot-font variable to Radiance, so the set of readouts does not change. A digit inside a label or a signage line still stays in that line's face. Reading text stays Barlow.

rules.name: The Reserved Space Rule
rules.body: Nothing moves between entry, answering, locked, and reveal. Phase-dependent text has a minimum height (prompt 1.9em, state line 1.4em, verdict 3em on desktop and 6.75em under 720px). Phase-dependent content is hidden with visibility: hidden, never display: none, so its box stays. Cell footers and split rows have fixed heights. The verdict placeholder draws a field of ghost-2 dots on an 8px grid in the verdict's box while the round runs, then swaps to text at reveal.

rules.name: The Reserved Ritual Rule
rules.body: Every component the Dota 2 skin adds reserves its box before it has anything to show. The HUD numbers hold a 3ch width and show an en dash until reveal. The state line always carries 2px vertical padding and a 1px transparent border, so the streak banner at reveal paints into space already held and extends 14px past the text on each side by a negative margin. The gold float holds 4.5ch beside the points. The streak name under the Streak caption holds 1.3em. The cooldown overlay and the padlock are drawn hidden over every well. The prompt holds 3em under 720px.

rules.name: The Three Blacks Rule
rules.body: Ground, module, and ghost are the only depth. A surface never gets a shadow, a glow, a border, or a tint to lift it.

rules.name: The Hairline Frame Rule
rules.body: In the Dota 2 skin a frame is a 1px gold hairline over a 1px dark inset line, with no blur and no offset, drawn on every module, cell, and action at rest. The frame is never a state: a surface that lights by fill loses its inset line for as long as it is lit.

rules.name: The Instant Swap Rule
rules.body: No element has a transition. Every state change (phase, pick, lock, reveal, hover, fog stage) is a one-frame swap of class and colour. The only animations are the ticker scroll (48s linear loop, paused on hover), the crowd-breaker keycap blink (0.5s, steps(1)), and the 700ms reveal flash, which is a class added and removed by script. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the ticker stops scrolling and steps in place, the keycap blink is removed, and the flash remains as a single instant swap.

dos: Do set every readout (clock, percent, points, counts) in Doto with tabular numerals.
Do reserve the box for every phase-dependent element: minimum heights on text, fixed heights on footers and split rows, visibility: hidden for content that is not yet shown.
Do show state by fill: a picked cell fills amber, a right cell fills green, a wrong cell fills red, each with black ink and an inverted keycap.
Do draw unlit dots and cells rather than hiding them: 16% opacity for split dots, ghost-2 for bar cells.
Do separate modules by 12px of ground and join stats or rows with 1px seams.
Do keep the 2px amber focus ring with 2px offset on every control.
Do use a 6px LED square between label items in place of punctuation.
Do swap colour across the whole band once at reveal, for 700ms, and leave the ground matte.

Do ship a new game as one `theme-<game>.css` loaded after `board.css` on a `body.skin-<game>` page, changing material, type faces, and ornament, and adding that game's rituals only inside the shell's modules.

Do reserve the box for every skin component before it has content: an en dash in the HUD numbers, a transparent border and padding on the state line, 4.5ch for the gold float, 1.3em for the streak name.
Do keep the inset line off every lit fill in the Dota 2 skin: picked, correct, wrong, and Play now show no dark inset.
Do keep attribute colours to the 2px group-heading underline and the 8px split-row square.
Do set every Dota 2 signage role and readout in Radiance 700 and leave reading text in Barlow.
Do use Dire red text, not the fill red, for red text smaller than the clock in the Dota 2 skin.
donts: Don't add transitions, easing, fades, or slides. Every change is instant.

Don't use colour gradients, glows, blur halos, tints, or shadows. A radial gradient is only ever a dot stencil. The Dota 2 skin's four client materials (HUD tints, streak banner, coin, fog wash) are the recorded exceptions and are never states.
Don't round a corner. The Dota 2 skin's half-disc dial and round coin are the recorded exceptions.
Don't use amber for anything that is not live. It is a state, not an accent.
Don't use breaker gold anywhere but the 2x crowd-breaker keycap or well, and the picked well's inner frame in the Dota 2 skin.
Don't show state with a border. Fill the surface. Inset outlines are allowed only on image tiles where a fill would hide the art.
Don't let a phase change move, resize, or reflow anything on the board.
Don't set a heading, label, or button in sentence case or in Barlow. Signage is Barlow Condensed uppercase; in the Dota 2 skin it is Radiance 700 uppercase.
Don't let a skin change the module layout, the phase geometry, the 100-dot bars, the reveal flip, or which role a state colour plays.
Don't use an attribute colour for state, text, or a fill.
Don't use Find Match green anywhere but the lobby's primary action.
Don't add a second display face to the Dota 2 skin. Radiance is the one signage face, and no serif stands in for it.
